newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia names 4 local banks as co-leads on Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia names 4 local banks as co-leads on Eurobond.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry has chosen four local banks to co-manage its second Eurobond issue, Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said on Friday.

The ministry has chosen Bank Imperial, Rossiisky Kredit, Mezhdunarodnaya Finansovaya Kompaniya and Alfa-Bank to be four of 20 co-managing banks of the mark-denominated Eurobond issue, Livshits told a news conference.
"The decision is taken," he said. "These four and no one else will be the managers."
Russia chose CS First Boston and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell to lead-manage the issue.
Russia will issue between 1.5 and 2.0 billion marks in Eurobond in a week after a road-show in Zurich and Frankfurt is completed.
